nome_en: Storm Kaiser Double Cross, the Awakened Flame Storm
nome_jp: 炎風の覚醒者ストーム・カイザーXX
testo:
Speed Attacker
Double Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put a Fire Bird that costs 5 or less or a Dragon that costs 5 or less from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
